title: Enterprise federation and independent security qualification

subtasks.description: Qualify customer OIDC federation and SAML via supported broker; document callback, claim mapping and account linking.
Map groups to explicit application memberships/roles and define deprovisioning without pretending OIDC provides SCIM.
Enforce privileged MFA and test disabled users, revoked sessions, group removal and controlled break-glass access.
Run dependency/container/SBOM/secret scans and triage findings by reachable exploitability and supported versions.
Commission a scoped independent penetration test of API, browser, tenancy, upload, shares, jobs and private topology.
Remediate critical/high findings and retest; publish only the actual report scope/date and approved customer summary.
